newsitem.title: UK: LME copper eases in late trading.
newsitem.headline: LME copper eases in late trading.

text.p: LME copper eased in late inter-office trading on Friday, while aluminium was little changed.
Three months London Metal Exchange (LME) copper was indicated at $2,327/$2,332 at 1900 GMT, compared to a kerb close which was just $4 down at $2,336.

"Overall the markets have remained subdued, while awaiting fresh impetus," brokers Rudolf Wolff said in a coommentary. Light trade buying had emerged to help copper challenge resistance during the day, but once U.S. markets opened renewed fund selling drove prices back towards opening levels.

Aluminium, which had looked the strongest of the complex at the kerb close, was little changed, getting to $1,623/$1,625, compared with a kerb close of $1,624.00. "Aluminium is holding up reasonably well," brokers Wolff said, although they cited technical indicators as pointing lower.
